title: Add a "turn off screen" button
line: The Brightness & Color applet now has a Turn Off Screen button in its header and right-click menu.
explanation: The Brightness & Color applet could dim the screen but offered no way to turn it off; that was only reachable through powerdevil's "Turn Off Screen" global shortcut, which has no default key on desktops. The change adds a high-priority "Turn Off Screen" action to the applet, so it shows as a button in the popup header (like Bluetooth's on/off button) and in the right-click menu. It closes the popup and invokes powerdevil's existing shortcut over D-Bus, so the "lock screen before turning off" setting is honored exactly as with the hotkey.

commits.message:
applets/brightness: add a Turn Off Screen button

The applet lets you dim the screen but not turn it off, so doing that
needed a global shortcut that the user may not have set. Add a header
button that closes the popup and triggers powerdevil's Turn Off Screen.

BUG: 480298

From 2dc0cbd9c4eb76ae236cea5eddc777f3b4b20162 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>

Subject: [PATCH] applets/brightness: add a Turn Off Screen button

The applet lets you dim the screen but not turn it off, so doing that
needed a global shortcut that the user may not have set. Add a header
button that closes the popup and triggers powerdevil's Turn Off Screen.

BUG: 480298
---
 applets/brightness/main.qml | 17 +++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 17 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/brightness/main.qml b/applets/brightness/main.qml
index 3eb523b34..58f074b67 100644
--- a/applets/brightness/main.qml
+++ b/applets/brightness/main.qml
@@ -19,6 +19,7 @@ import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.kitemmodels as KItemModels
+import org.kde.plasma.workspace.dbus as DBus
 
 import org.kde.plasma.private.brightnesscontrolplugin
 
@@ -252,6 +253,22 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     } // todo
 
     Plasmoid.contextualActions: [
+        PlasmaCore.Action {
+            icon.name: "monitor-symbolic"
+            text: i18nc("@action:button", "Turn Off Screen")
+            priority: PlasmaCore.Action.HighPriority
+            onTriggered: {
+                brightnessAndColorControl.expanded = false;
+                DBus.SessionBus.asyncCall({
+                    service: "org.kde.kglobalaccel",
+                    path: "/component/org_kde_powerdevil",
+                    iface: "org.kde.kglobalaccel.Component",
+                    member: "invokeShortcut",
+                    arguments: ["Turn Off Screen"],
+                    signature: "(s)",
+                });
+            }
+        },
         PlasmaCore.Action {
             id: configureNightLight
             icon.name: "redshift-status-on"
--

media.caption: Brightness & Color popup on master: no way to turn the screen off
New Turn Off Screen button in the popup header
Turn Off Screen also in the right-click menu

reviews.text: Adding a Turn Off Screen action to the Brightness & Color applet is desirable, but this implementation relies on a layer-violating workaround and has a serious UX hazard. Rather than invoking a proper PowerDevil DPMS D-Bus method and checking DPMS availability, PowerDevil's own applet round-trips through org.kde.kglobalaccel's invokeShortcut("Turn Off Screen"), so the button stays visible and silently fails when DPMS or PowerDevil is unavailable. Putting it as a HighPriority contextual action also renders an unlabeled generic monitor-symbolic icon next to the pin button in the System Tray header (which looks like Display Settings rather than an immediate screen-off action) and omits any button from the popup when the applet is used standalone outside the System Tray.
changes: Expose and call a proper PowerDevil DPMS turn-off method and availability flag (e.g., via org.kde.Solid.PowerManagement.Actions.DPMSControl / brightnesscontrolplugin) instead of invoking the "Turn Off Screen" global shortcut through org.kde.kglobalaccel, and hide or disable the action when DPMS or PowerDevil is unavailable.

Replace the ambiguous unlabeled monitor-symbolic header button with a clear, labeled "Turn Off Screen" control (e.g., a button in PopupDialog.qml or an unmistakable screen-off icon with label) so users do not accidentally blank/lock their screen mistaking it for Display Settings and so it is also available when the applet is placed outside the System Tray.
